Product_Name: Google Nest Protect - Smoke Alarm - Smoke Detector and Carbon Monoxide Detector - Wired, White
Ai_text: Customers like the ease of installation, performance, quality and brightness of the gas smoke fire alarm. They mention that the instructions are clear, the unit works great and offers a step up level of performance. They appreciate the gentle early warning feature and the ability to hush an alarm from the app. Customers also appreciate appearance, and ease of use. However, some customers are mixed on connectivity, and value.
Description: Google Nest Protect (Wired) packaged with a Google Seal for Online Marketplace.
